name_en: Shenze County Shengda Textile Co., Ltd.
name_cn: 深泽县盛达纺织有限公司
main_products: TC, CVC, 100% cotton and TR fabrics for shirting, workwear and uniforms; pocketing; grey and dyed fabric
woven_evidence: Its company brochure and other sources describe a mill with 400-950 looms making shirting, workwear and pocketing fabric.

canton_fair.evidence_note: Named as a Shijiazhuang exhibitor at the 137th Canton Fair in a texnet.com.cn report.

notes: Registered in 2004 with a factory in the Zhaoba industrial zone of Shenze. Some listings also mention home-textile fabric and yarn, but shirting and workwear lead. Trade data shows exports to Vietnam, Bangladesh and the Philippines.
